title: Static Burst
blurb: Half a second of pink noise, shaped like an analogue radio losing its grip on a signal. Editors use it as a glitch transition because it hard-cuts attention in a way a clean edit cannot — the ear reads it as equipment failure and immediately pays attention. Pranksters use it mid-conversation to convince somebody their headphones are dying, which works far more often than it should. It cuts through any mix instantly, which is the entire reason both applications succeed. Original generated noise, free to download and use anywhere.
origin: Generated pink-noise burst, shaped like an analog radio dropout.
